title: An unverified required undo stops additional paid repair work
steps: Run the real step-nine repair lifecycle with a required undo refusal or exception, then exercise failures during numbering, native waiting and later rollback waits.
expect: No later page, remaining batch or resend starts a paid prompt after a required undo is unverified.
Already accepted requests stay in the ledger for settlement and judgement.
The result remains incomplete and never claims the failed undo succeeded.
fence: Do not cancel or abandon accepted writers, bypass undo verification, or restore a backup while writes are open.

tests: an unverified required undo stops later repair prompts (refused)
a required undo failure during request numbering prevents the first paid prompt
a required undo failure while awaiting a missing turn prevents a paid resend
a failed undo stops new work before the next rollback call finishes
